title: Approximation by interval smoothing
statement: Let $\eta>0$, let $c\ge0$, and let $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ be $c$-Lipschitz. For every $x\in\mathbb R$, $|S_\eta\psi(x)-\psi(x)|\le c\eta$.
replaced: For $\eta>0$ and a real function $\psi$, write $S_\eta\psi(x)=\eta^{-1}\int_0^\eta\psi(x+t)\,dt$. If $\psi$ is $c$-Lipschitz for $c\ge0$, then $|S_\eta\psi(x)-\psi(x)|\le c\eta$ for every real $x$.
